qualifier: electron transport and ATP synthesis plus respiratory complex assembly
name: Mitochondrial electron transport, ATP synthesis and complex assembly
rationale: All members concern the respiratory chain and ATP synthase, either their operation or assembly/inner-membrane insertion; unlike the confusables, the theme has the electron transport and chemiosmotic ATP synthesis steps and lacks mitochondrial translation and Fe-S cluster assembly.

qualifier: vitamin B6 and molybdenum cofactor, sulfide oxidation, serine
name: Vitamin B6 and molybdenum cofactor, sulfide and serine metabolism
rationale: Members span prosthetic cofactor metabolism (PLP, molybdenum cofactor), hydrogen sulfide oxidation and serine metabolism/transport; the cofactor and sulfide components separate it from the amino acid catabolism and transsulfuration confusables.

qualifier: NTHL1 defects and APEX1 displacement of the glycosylase
name: NTHL1-defective base excision and APEX1 glycosylase displacement
rationale: All three members concern the DNA glycosylase step of base excision repair (defective NTHL1 binding/processing and APEX1 handoff), distinguishing it from OGG1 defects, lesion cleavage and downstream gap-filling confusables.

name: Co-receptor regulation of T and NK cell activation
rationale: Members concern costimulatory/inhibitory receptor control of T cell, NK cell and dendritic cell activation; unlike confusables focused on dendritic cells or NK cells alone, the theme spans T cell costimulation and NK/T cytotoxicity restraint.

qualifier: inhibition of nonsense-mediated decay and nuclear export control
name: mRNA stabilization, export and translation, inhibiting nonsense-mediated decay
rationale: All members promote mRNA persistence or use (IGF2BP/CRD stabilization, blocked deadenylation and NMD, export, cytoplasmic translation); NMD inhibition and export distinguish it from miRNA silencing, stress granule and decapping confusables.

name: RUNX3-centred tumour-suppressive transcription of growth-arrest genes
rationale: Members are RUNX3 (and FOXO) transcriptional control of cell-cycle, apoptosis, WNT and YAP1 targets; the RUNX3 focus separates it from TGF-beta/SMAD, Hippo and CDH1 transcription confusables.

qualifier: efflux, uptake, storage and HDL assembly
name: Cellular cholesterol efflux, uptake, storage and HDL assembly
rationale: Members regulate cellular cholesterol import, efflux to HDL, storage/foam cell formation and synthesis; unlike confusables centred on lipoprotein remodelling, chylomicrons and intestinal absorption, it covers cell-level cholesterol storage and synthesis control.

name: Type 2 cytokine (IL-4, IL-13, IL-33) signalling and production
rationale: All members concern production or signalling of IL-4, IL-13 or IL-33; the cytokine-level focus distinguishes it from confusables about Th2 differentiation, eosinophils, mast cells and IgE switching.

qualifier: chondroitin, dermatan and heparan sulfate, with inherited defects
name: Chondroitin, dermatan and heparan sulfate proteoglycan biosynthesis and disorders
rationale: Members are the linkage region and CS/DS/HS/heparin chain biosynthesis and their enzyme-defect disorders, distinguishing it from keratan sulfate and Notch O-glycosylation confusables.

core: Glycan chain elongation and terminal capping
name: Terminal elongation and sialylation of N- and O-glycans
rationale: Members concern extension and termination of N- and O-glycan chains (antennae elongation, poly-LacNAc, core 1 synthesis, sialylation), unlike confusables on O-GalNAc initiation, N-glycan trimming or fucosylated blood group antigens.

qualifier: inhibitory receptor control of B cells and phagocytes
name: Fc-gamma receptor phagocytosis with inhibitory receptor control
rationale: Members cover Fc-gamma receptor signalling and phagocytic cup formation plus inhibitory receptors (CD22, SIRPs, inhibitory Fc signalling) that restrain B cells and phagocytes; this inhibitory arm and phagocytosis separate it from BCR, ADCC and hypersensitivity confusables.

name: Erythroid differentiation and heme biosynthesis
rationale: Members describe red cell differentiation, oxygen transport and heme synthesis; combining both distinguishes it from confusables that have only erythroid differentiation or only heme/Fe-S biosynthesis.

name: Glycerol and polyol metabolism with phosphatidate-to-triglyceride synthesis
rationale: Members concern glycerol, glycerol-3-phosphate, alditol and fructose metabolism and the PA-DAG-TAG synthesis they feed; the polyol/glycerol arm distinguishes it from triglyceride catabolism, lipid droplet and glycerol transport confusables.

name: Atypical and branched polyubiquitin chain formation
rationale: Members are E3-mediated ubiquitination with K6, K11, K27, K29, branched and free chains, distinguishing it from deubiquitination, ERAD/quality control and ISG15 confusables.

core: Toll-like receptor signalling and its regulation
name: TRIF-dependent toll-like receptor signalling to TBK1-IRF3 and its regulation
rationale: Members are TRIF/TICAM1-dependent TLR3/4 signalling (TBK1-IRF3, RIP1-IKK, TRAF6-TAK1, cell death) and TLR regulation; the TRIF-TBK1-IRF3 arm distinguishes it from NF-kappaB, IRAK, NOD and TLR-cytokine confusables.

qualifier: purine and pyrimidine synthesis, salvage, catabolism and transport
name: Purine and pyrimidine nucleotide synthesis, salvage, catabolism and transport
rationale: Nearly all members concern de novo synthesis, salvage, degradation, interconversion or transport of purine/pyrimidine nucleotides and nucleoside analogue drugs, unlike confusables on one-carbon/methionine, amino acid or creatine metabolism.

name: Bile acid synthesis, enterohepatic transport and signalling
rationale: Members cover bile acid synthesis from cholesterol, transport/recycling, secretion and bile acid signalling; these separate it from sterol absorption, peroxisomal oxidation and xenobiotic transport confusables.

qualifier: negative feedback on FGF receptors (Sprouty, FGFRL1)
name: FGFR3 signalling and negative feedback of FGF receptors
rationale: Members are FGFR3 ligand binding, FRS/SHC cascades and activating mutants plus Sprouty/FGFRL1 negative regulation; FGFR3 and the negative-feedback arm distinguish it from FGFR1/2/4 and PI3K/PLC cascade confusables.

core: Mesenchymal stem cell proliferation and differentiation
qualifier: TGF-beta, BMP and Wnt morphogen signalling
name: Morphogen (TGF-beta, BMP, Wnt) control of mesenchymal stem cells
rationale: Members concern mesenchymal progenitor expansion and differentiation under TGF-beta/SMAD, BMP and Wnt signalling, distinguishing it from confusables on osteoblast differentiation and ossification.

qualifier: lipoprotein particle remodelling and phospholipid efflux
name: HDL assembly, lipoprotein remodelling and cholesterol/phospholipid efflux
rationale: Members concern HDL formation via ABC-transporter efflux of cholesterol and phospholipid and HDL/LDL particle remodelling; remodelling and phospholipid efflux distinguish it from confusables centred on ABCA1 defects, apoA-I signalling and cholesterol response.

name: Fc-epsilon receptor I signalling in type I hypersensitivity
rationale: All members are FcERI downstream signalling (MAPK, NF-kappaB, calcium, LAT2) or type I hypersensitivity, distinguishing it from Fc-gamma/BCR signalling and mast cell differentiation/degranulation confusables.

name: MHC class I presentation, cross-presentation and HIV Nef/Vpu evasion
rationale: Members cover class I peptide loading, proteasomal processing and cross-presentation plus HIV Nef/Vpu downregulation of MHC-I, CD4, CD8 and CD28; class I focus and viral evasion separate it from class II, proteasome and PD-L1 confusables.

name: Dendrite arborization and spine plasticity downstream of NMDA receptors
rationale: Members concern dendrite branching, spine morphogenesis, postsynaptic actin, synaptic translation and long-term plasticity; NMDAR-RAC1 signalling and plasticity distinguish it from filopodium, postsynaptic density and BDNF/EPHB confusables.

name: Myeloid differentiation and CCR2/CX3CR1 monocyte recruitment
rationale: Members regulate monocyte, macrophage, dendritic cell and granulocyte differentiation and monocyte chemokine-receptor identity; the CCR2/CX3CR1 monocyte modules distinguish it from myeloid progenitor and CSF signalling confusables.

qualifier: incretin, fatty-acid receptor and cholinergic inputs
name: Incretin, fatty-acid and cholinergic stimulation of insulin secretion
rationale: Members concern GLP-1/GIP incretins, free fatty acid receptors and acetylcholine promoting insulin secretion, distinguishing it from inhibitory adrenergic, glucagon and somatostatin confusables.
